name: Question 18
worked_solution:
Taking the natural logarithm of both sides and applying the laws of logarithms, we get the following: 

$$
\begin{aligned}3{(\frac{1}{5})}^{x-2} & >{3}^{2-3x} \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡[3{(\frac{1}{5})}^{x-2}] & >\operatorname{ln}⁡({3}^{2-3x}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡3+\operatorname{ln}⁡[{(\frac{1}{5})}^{x-2}] & >\operatorname{ln}⁡({3}^{2-3x}) \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡3+(x-2)\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{1}{5}) & >(2-3x)\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡3+(x-2)(\operatorname{ln}⁡1-\operatorname{ln}⁡5) & >(2-3x)\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡3+(x-2)(0-\operatorname{ln}⁡5) & >(2-3x)\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡3+(2-x)\operatorname{ln}⁡5 & >(2-3x)\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡3+2\operatorname{ln}⁡5-x\operatorname{ln}⁡5 & >2\operatorname{ln}⁡3-3x\operatorname{ln}⁡3 \\ 3x\operatorname{ln}⁡3-x\operatorname{ln}⁡5 & >2\operatorname{ln}⁡3-\operatorname{ln}⁡3-2\operatorname{ln}⁡5 \\ x(3\operatorname{ln}⁡3-\operatorname{ln}⁡5) & >\operatorname{ln}⁡3-2\operatorname{ln}⁡5 \\ x & >\frac{\operatorname{ln}⁡3-2\operatorname{ln}⁡5}{3\operatorname{ln}⁡3-\operatorname{ln}⁡5}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 18
?

Solve the inequality 3(15)x−2>32−3x.

a
x>3ln⁡3−ln⁡52ln⁡5
b
x>ln⁡3−2ln⁡53ln⁡3−ln⁡5
c
x<ln⁡3+2ln⁡53ln⁡3+ln⁡5
d
x<ln⁡3−2ln⁡53ln⁡3
e
x>ln⁡3+2ln⁡53ln⁡3+ln⁡5
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Taking the natural logarithm of both sides and applying the laws of logarithms, we get the following: 3(15)x−2>32−3xln⁡[3(15)x−2]>ln⁡(32−3x)ln⁡3+ln⁡[(15)x−2]>ln⁡(32−3x)ln⁡3+(x−2)ln⁡(15)>(2−3x)ln⁡3ln⁡3+(x−2)(ln⁡1−ln⁡5)>(2−3x)ln⁡3ln⁡3+(x−2)(0−ln⁡5)>(2−3x)ln⁡3ln⁡3+(2−x)ln⁡5>(2−3x)ln⁡3ln⁡3+2ln⁡5−xln⁡5>2ln⁡3−3xln⁡33xln⁡3−xln⁡5>2ln⁡3−ln⁡3−2ln⁡5x(3ln⁡3−ln⁡5)>ln⁡3−2ln⁡5x>ln⁡3−2ln⁡53ln⁡3−ln⁡5
